status.local-only: Local only · Cloud sync is off
status.error: Sync failed · Latest changes are not confirmed uploaded

conflict: The cloud workspace differs from this page. Automatic sync is paused. Choose which version to keep.
confirmRemote: Replace this page's BOX, settings, and schedule with the latest cloud version. Unsynced changes on this page will be replaced.
confirmLocal: Replace the cloud workspace with this page's BOX, settings, and schedule. If another device changes the cloud again, you will see another conflict.
syncError_consent: Cloud sync is paused until you accept the current terms and privacy policy. Your local data is unchanged.
syncError_policy: The terms or privacy policy have changed since this page was opened. Refresh to review the latest versions before consenting. Your local data is retained.
syncError_invalid: Cloud sync rejected this data and will not resend it unchanged. Check your operator progression or re-import your data. Your local copy is retained.
syncError_retry: Cloud sync is temporarily unavailable or rate limited. It will retry after a cooldown; your local data is retained.
syncError_session: Your login has expired. Sign in again to resume cloud sync. Your local data is retained.
syncError_paused: Cloud sync is paused after an error. Your local data is retained; you can try again later.
